upstreamShift.summary: Two decoupled themes hit seam-2 in BASE..NEW. (1) `refactor(agent): make runtime identity explicit` — TypertGatewayService.startRemoteEvent no longer routes through `typert.contexts.identifyHost` to derive the Agent identity; instead it reads `source.context.agentId` directly (added as a required field on `TypertRemoteEventContext` in src/types.ts). Delegation-to-Host on unavailable Contexts is DROPPED (test 'delegates unavailable Contexts' becomes 'rejects malformed scoped invocations and delegates a released Context'; `pendingInvocation` fixture signature grows an `identity` param). (2) `packages/api/remotes` client assembly gains a new upstream contribution `sessionFeedbackRemote` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-command-feedback/remote` — added to imports, type re-exports, mount loop, package.json devDeps + tsconfig.client composite ref (`../../feedback/command-feedback`). Also: `goal/activation-changed` added to `API_REMOTE_FORWARDED_EVENTS`; `goal/goal` composite ref added to tsconfig.host. Plus: `carrierFailure` + `cancelledFailure` become exported (were private) in gateway src/client/index.ts (surface expansion). Version bump 0.1.3-alpha.2 -> 0.1.5-rc.2 in both package.json. gateway-stream.host.spec.ts loses 70 net lines as identifyHost-registration boilerplate disappears. No adds/deletes — all 19 files are Modified.

packages/api/remotes/src/remote-events.ts: `goal/activation-changed` added to `API_REMOTE_FORWARDED_EVENTS` in an alphabetically-adjacent slot (after `credentials/reference-updated`, before `cordis/request-run`).

packages/api/gateway/tests/gateway-stream.host.spec.ts: -70 net lines. `pendingInvocation` fixture grows an `identity` parameter, and all the `ctx.typert.contexts.registerHost('agent', {...})` calls in test scenarios collapse into that param. Test title 'delegates unavailable Contexts and rejects malformed scoped invocations' → 'rejects malformed scoped invocations and delegates a released Context'.

packages/api/remotes/tests/remote-events.host.spec.ts: adds a `goal/activation-changed` emit assertion pair; the 'user-questions/request' scenario now asserts agent object carries `id: 'agent-1'` (aligns to the direct-identity refactor).
breakingChanges: `TypertRemoteEventContext.agentId: string` becomes required — any callsite that constructs this shape (only 1 producer is the gateway itself + test fixtures) must supply it or fail typecheck.

Removal of `identifyHost`-based delegate-to-Host path in startRemoteEvent means: an invocation with no live Agent no longer returns `{kind:'next'}` (delegation) — it now raises `TypeError('typert gateway: scoped Remote events require a non-empty Agent identity')`. Any fork or plug-in relying on the delegation-to-Host fallback path is silently broken.
`carrierFailure` / `cancelledFailure` becoming exported is additive (safe) but is now a versioned API surface.
